fullPassage: When I worked for a large electronics company that manufactured laser and ink-jet printers, I soon discovered why there are often three versions of many consumer goods. If the manufacturer makes only one version of its product, people who bought it might have been willing to spend more money, so the company is losing some income. If the company offers two versions, one with more features and more expensive than the other, people will compare the two models and still buy the less expensive one. But if the company introduces a third model with even more features and more expensive than the other two, sales of the second model go up; many people like the features of the most expensive model, but not the price. The middle item has more features than the least expensive one, and it is less expensive than the fanciest model. They buy the middle item, unaware that they have been manipulated by the presence of the higher-priced item.

❌ ① save(아끼다)는 '더 쓸 의향이 있었다'는 흐름과 반대
❌ ③ ignore(무시하다)는 '두 모델을 비교한다(compare)'는 문맥과 반대

det.korean: 사람이나 상황을 교묘하게, 흔히 부당하게 조종하거나 영향을 주다.
det.analysis:
✅ ④ manipulate(조종하다): 교묘하게·부당하게 조종한다는 뜻 ←정답
❌ ① compare(비교하다) 부적합
❌ ② introduce(도입하다) 부적합
❌ ③ manufacture(제조하다) 부적합
det.tip: manipulate(조종하다). be manipulated by ~(~에 의해 조종당하다).

questions.passage: When I worked for a large electronics company that __________ (manufacture) laser and ink-jet printers, I soon discovered why there are often three versions of many consumer goods.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: a large electronics company that __________ (manufacture) → 관계사 that 뒤 과거시제 동사 → manufactured.
det.analysis:
빈칸은 관계대명사 that 뒤에 오는 동사 자리예요. 앞의 '내가 일했다(worked)'와 같은 과거 이야기라, 동사에 -ed를 붙인 과거형을 써요. 원형 manufacture → 과거형 manufactured.
a company that manufactured printers = 프린터를 제조하던 회사.
det.tip: 관계사 that + 과거형 동사 → that manufactured. manufacture → manufactured.

questions.passage: The middle item has more features than the least expensive one, and it is less expensive than the fanciest model. They buy the middle item, unaware that they have been __________ (manipulate) by the presence of the higher-priced item.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 문맥에 맞게 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 (1단어) (영어로) 쓰시오.

det.korean: they have been __________ (manipulate) → have been 뒤 수동(과거분사) → manipulated.
det.analysis:
빈칸은 'have been ____'로 have been 뒤 자리예요. '(그들이) 조종을 당했다'라는 수동의 뜻이라, 동사에 -ed를 붙인 과거분사를 써요. 원형 manipulate → 과거분사 manipulated.
have been manipulated = (그들은) 조종당해 왔다.
det.tip: have been + 과거분사(수동완료) → have been manipulated. manipulate → manipulated.

questions.passage: When I worked for a large electronics company that manufactured laser and ink-jet printers, I soon discovered why there are often three versions of many consumer goods. If the manufacturer makes only one version of its product, people who bought it might have been willing to spend more money, so the company is losing some income. If the company offers two versions, one with more features and more expensive than the other, people will compare the two models and still buy __________. But if the company introduces a third model with even more features and more expensive than the other two, sales of the second model go up; many people like the features of the most expensive model, but not the price. The middle item has more features than the least expensive one, and it is less expensive than the fanciest model. They buy the middle item, unaware that they have been manipulated by the presence of the higher-priced item.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 두 모델을 비교하고 결국 더 저렴한 것(the less expensive one)을 산다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① the less expensive one(더 저렴한 것): 두 버전만 있으면 비교 후 싼 것을 산다는 흐름 ←정답
❌ ② the most expensive one(가장 비싼 것) 문맥 반대
❌ ③ a brand-new model(완전 새 모델) 본문 근거 없음
❌ ④ nothing at all(아무것도 안 산다) 부적합
det.tip: compare and buy the less expensive one(비교 후 싼 것을 사다).

If the manufacturer makes only one version of its product, people who bought it might have been willing to spend more money, so the company is losing some income. But if the company introduces a third model with even more features and more expensive than the other two, sales of the second model __________; many people like the features of the most expensive model, but not the price. They buy the middle item, unaware that they have been manipulated by the presence of the higher-priced item.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 세 번째 모델을 도입하면 두 번째 모델의 판매가 올라간다(go up).
det.analysis:
✅ ③ go up(오르다): 더 비싼 세 번째 모델이 생기면 중간 모델 판매가 '오른다'는 흐름 ←정답
❌ ① stay flat(변화 없다) 문맥 반대
❌ ② run out(다 떨어지다) 부적합
❌ ④ fall apart(무너지다) 부적합
det.tip: sales go up(판매가 오르다).
